h:
只要互联网上还剩下两张图片，就会有人想要将其中一张的风格转移到另一张上。

该工作流程非常擅长将图像的风格转移到另一图像上，同时保留目标图像的大元素。

它在原始图像上使用万寿菊深度检测，并使用 controlnet 深度图和 IP 适配器创建新图像，并在 BLIP 图像字幕或您自己的提示中提供一点帮助。

o.en:
As long as there are two images left on the internet, somebody will want to style transfer one to the other.

This workflow is very good at transferring the style of image onto another image, while preserving the target image's large elements.

It uses marigold depth detection on the original image and creates a new image using controlnet depth map and IP Adapter, with a little bit of help from either BLIP image captioning or your own prompt.
